contracts.claim: Unknown scopes are read-only; edit adds only workspace.write
Only a named CAS workspace.write grants edit scope
Every observed model call stays visible once, with its measured tokens, and judgement/frontier calls follow item order
Item routes preserve receipts; completed manual/script counts and total tokens come only from durable observations
Final verification text names the real tool, target, observed path and exact operation/value
Frame clicks map from shown pixels to capture pixels and outside/empty frames are refused
Characters, named keys and chords retain exact modifiers; dead/modifier keys never send input
Dominant axis determines direction; gesture amount is 1â€“10 lines with pixel/line/page conversion
Choose the smallest containing observed element, preserve first match on equal area
Named sessions must exist; otherwise the most recent live session wins, with ended fallback
Updates preserve entry identity and data; new rows are sequence sorted and bounded
Typed pane target preserves the caller's full path/session identifier
Only image/file paths, HTTP(S) URLs and integer window targets are accepted; delimiters in paths/session ids survive
Undocking requires crossing a known dock boundary by the requested margin
Floating drops choose nearest side and a clamped vertical fraction
Only local move, remote take and local-to-remote send are offered; remote-to-remote is refused
Remote writes require inbox, writable share or explicit write-anywhere permission
Known byte progress clamps to 0..1; unknown sizes stay unknown except completed transfers
Other-PC navigation preserves path delimiters
Only pc: identifiers are decoded, splitting device once and preserving all path bars
Transfer labels preserve bytes, file counts, failure reason, measured speed and rounded remaining time
Before adding bytes, each image has a supported MIME, fits six-count/per-file/aggregate limits, and every refusal explains the gate
Unsupported, oversized and over-count metadata never reaches FileReader; estimated base64 totals obey limits
Metadata byte counts become rounded base64 quadruplets
Only bytes following the first data URL comma are kept
Only image-capable apps and models admit images on either route; blocked choices explain the app/model
Retry identity includes canonical options and every image's byte digest, MIME/name/size; no image bytes are retained
Only read mutability is presented as non-mutating
Argument examples contain exactly required fields with enum/default/type initial values
Tools receive JSON objects only; malformed JSON has an explicit error and empty input means an empty object
Every query term must match catalog text; available tools lead and names break ties
UI tools and desktop calls disclose their own state folder; ordinary workspace tools report the chat root
A draft write changes its named chat only and keeps one stable empty value for subscriptions
Committed attachment bytes pass the second admission gate and origin drafts stay within limits
Only classify/plan suffixes identify planning turns; acceptance verifier remains a task
Job paging upserts by id with later data and keeps newest-created first
Goal, folder, acceptance checks and all required planner/executor/verifier routes are required
Worker terminal status overrides saved phase; dependency levels, totals, unknown usage and one-time start/pause/resume controls remain honest
Native selection never changes implicitly; browser reload affinity follows only one same-project/context replacement
Explicit known tabs win, then launcher app aliases, then embedded Browser 3D
Conditional controls show exactly fields whose predicates hold
Form defaults resolve duplicate keys according to their condition
Visible fields become exact bridge args; vectors/numbers are finite, JSON text must parse as an object and wildcard fields are flattened
Mission observers retain tasks, normalize unknown states, compute prerequisite levels and progress, and preserve draft/paused/stopped phases
Mission drafts need a goal, folder, task prompts, acceptance and a positive optional budget
Creation trims fields, preserves harness/model routing and removes self/missing prerequisites; optional positive budget is rounded
Planning asks for the real mission.create tool and explicitly leaves starting to the person
Board excludes missions by default, retains dependency/missing/open/dependent edges and exact state counts
Only waiting, unarmed agent tasks can be armed; Paul's tasks are always excluded
Evidence retains its actual path, commit, run ids or owner-only command; labels disclose opening meaning
Morning summary counts only completed unreported runs and non-mission tasks; actual evidence links take precedence
Quiet windows are start-inclusive/end-exclusive in selected local/UTC clock; midnight wraps and equal endpoints mean all day
Every board task gets one measured leaf on its prerequisite branch with exact geometry and alternate sides without invented tasks
Saved policy fields convert measured seconds to one-decimal hours/minutes; toggles retain quiet/GPU/plan hold state and harness budgets
Budget patches convert valid fields to positive integer units and report every invalid count/time/OpenCode token budget
Stored junk cannot remove regions or add unknown widths/widgets; modes/defaults are normalized and duplicate widgets disappear
Region movement preserves all other layout fields and clamps target order
Region movement preserves all other layout fields and clamps target order
Pointer widths clamp to the selected region and leave all others intact
Keyboard resizing uses 16px or shifted 48px, with Home/End bounds and no action for unknown keys
Splitter sides follow region position relative to the conversation
Resize preserves saved values, gives proportional slack before dropping Canopy, keeps conversation comfort/minimum, then floats panel
Widget edits preserve layout, prevent duplicates, obey each widget's sizes and move only the requested item
Widget edits preserve layout, prevent duplicates, obey each widget's sizes and move only the requested item
Widget edits preserve layout, prevent duplicates, obey each widget's sizes and move only the requested item
Widget edits preserve layout, prevent duplicates, obey each widget's sizes and move only the requested item
Widget edits preserve layout, prevent duplicates, obey each widget's sizes and move only the requested item
Add list names exactly known widgets absent from layout
Direct interests win over tiers; unknown/missing tiers select nothing
Recommendations union selected interest resources in catalog order and preserve unconditional tour chapters
Tour duration is 60â€“90 seconds when nonempty, proportional chapters are contiguous and last chapter consumes rounding remainder
Every playhead maps to its containing chapter with clamped progress; empty tours have no chapter
Download percent uses measured bytes; busy/end/error words reflect state and measured ETA
Pack installation controls reflect actual availability and copying state; receipt detail names verified file count/bytes
Catalog gaps use plain tool names without hiding unavailable payloads
Only observed found runtimes produce set-to-start wording and names; no result stays checking
Plan replacement clears empty lists, add upserts by id/source, update preserves unknown ids, delete clears the last item
Only nonoptimistic live operations beyond the saved sequence fold onto the saved plan
Checklist progress normalizes states, counts completed items, chooses first active/next pending and recognizes nonempty completion
Unfinished checklists stay visible; complete lists remain only while agent works; empty lists hide
Absent plan fields preserve shown plan; explicit clears advance sequence to the read's last item
Reset words reflect measured rounded minutes/hours/days; missing reset is blank and elapsed reset is now
Provider warnings/rejections outrank percent; stale/unavailable/unknown limits never show reassuring green
Moving dashboard rows appear once in first-seen order; final page controls paging, first page keeps limits
Replay preserves sequence and real recorded span, excludes optimistic items, caps idle gaps and fills missing stamps without jumps
Exactly entries at or before the replay playhead are visible
Recorded clock follows the last visible entry and stays at start before the first
Playback wall time is replay time divided by at least 1x, rounded upward
Scrubber marks retain meaningful item identity/order, normalize position and distinguish tool errors
Measured spans round to seconds, then zero-padded minutes and hours
Catalog aliases join live rows once; readiness/capabilities/auth/model/owner policy are observed from their authoritative source
Ready and installed counts come from rendered runtime rows without inventing detection
Godot edit/interact and Unity test forms retain their typed bridge fields/defaults; other actions return valid field arrays

contracts.claim: An app is one window whatever it shows; a pane is one per kind and target; nothing else opens

contracts.claim: Each app and app pane wears its own skin (terminal code, PDF reader, notes notebook, files finder, 3D graphite, images darkroom, factory studio, research scholar, agents monitor); the shell's own panes wear none
